class.name: JobSystem
class.brief_description: Static facade for the GDJobSystem scheduler.
class.description: A GDExtension plugin exposing a multi-threaded Job System to GDScript. Call [method initialize] once, then schedule work with [method schedule], [method schedule_for] or [method schedule_parallel_for]. Callbacks run on worker threads: keep them free of scene-tree access.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the scheduler with the given number of worker threads (0 = auto). Idempotent. Enables the JobCostCache adaptive tile-learning strategy by default.

method.name: set_job_cost_cache_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables per-job cost EWMA adaptive tile learning. When enabled, batch sizes are solved per job from measured per-element cost; when disabled, a static tiles-per-worker heuristic is used.

method.name: is_job_cost_cache_enabled
method.description: Returns whether adaptive tile learning is currently enabled.

method.name: set_implicit_batch_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables native implicit batching. While enabled, tile-path jobs submitted from the main thread are collected and submitted together at the next flush point (single wake), Unity ScheduleBatchedJobs-style. complete(), is_completed() and flush_pending_submits() act as flush points.

method.name: flush_pending_submits
method.description: Force-flushes all collected pending jobs with a single wake. Call once per frame (e.g. end of frame) when implicit batching is enabled.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Stops all workers and releases scheduler resources.

method.name: get_worker_count
method.description: Returns the number of persistent worker threads.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the version of the GDJobSystem plugin.

method.name: schedule
method.description: Schedules a callable to run once on a worker thread. The returned handle completes when the job finishes.

method.name: schedule_for
method.description: Schedules callable(index) for index in [0, length) as a sequential job.

method.name: schedule_parallel_for
method.description: Schedules callable(index) for index in [0, length) split into batches of batch_size items executed in parallel across workers (0 = automatic).

method.name: combine_dependencies
method.description: Combines multiple JobSystemHandle into one handle that completes when all of them complete.
